## Standalone and slide embeds {#embedding}

Every application has a standalone page at `embed/<name>.html` that runs with zero network requests and works offline from a local site folder. Append `?preset=<id>` or state keys (such as `?tau=.20&w=.8`) to open a specific view, `?theme=light` or `?theme=dark` to pin the color scheme, and `?hide=chrome` (or any comma-separated combination of `title`, `caption`, `presets`, `disclosures`; source and license credits always remain visible) to fit lecture slides cleanly:

```html
<iframe src="https://joonho112.github.io/postrank-explorer/embed/frontier.html?preset=matched&hide=chrome"
  width="100%" height="560" style="border:0" loading="lazy"
  title="The error-disclosure frontier"></iframe>
```
